title: Decision: kith-core as error and type hub
description: kith-core is the only crate that depends on almost nothing (just serde), and all other crates import error types and core data structures from it. This prevents circular dependencies, enforces a clean architecture boundary, and ensures consistent error handling across the entire system. Dependency graph is acyclic and clear.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — rationale note affirming correct architectural decision (kith-core as error/type hub). Not a finding; describes correct existing structure. No action needed.
